paragraphs.source_en: Day had crept upon the city. Though the rain still fell, a vague light suffused the eastern sky. And with the sun arrived the Shavepate. Skahaz was clad in his familiar garb of pleated black skirt, greaves, and muscled breastplate. The brazen mask beneath his arm was new—a wolf’s head with lolling tongue. “So,” he said, by way of greeting, “the fool is dead, is he?”

units.source_en: Day had crept upon the city.
Though the rain still fell, a vague light suffused the eastern sky.
And with the sun arrived the Shavepate.
Skahaz was clad in his familiar garb of pleated black skirt, greaves, and muscled breastplate.
The brazen mask beneath his arm was new—a wolf’s head with lolling tongue.
“So,” he said, by way of greeting, “the fool is dead, is he?”
